title: Nestswipe — Decodo usage
description: Provider-reported residential traffic for the entire Decodo account. Polled directly every 15 minutes; upstream reporting may lag 10–15 minutes. Download + upload = total. Rolling totals are gauges: do not sum samples or directions. These are not remaining credits or a billing-period balance. No synthetic listing requests. A failed poll emits no bandwidth value. Last successful collection: nestswipe.decodo.last_success_timestamp.
